newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil January daily exports at $164.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil January daily exports at $164.8 mln.

text.p: Brazil's average daily exports so far in January were $164.8 million, bringing exports for the month so far to $2.801 billion, a Ministry of Industry and Commerce spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said exports in the fourth week of the month were $907 million, averaging $181.4 million a day.
In the third week of January, average daily exports were a meager $153.2 million compared with $162.4 million in the second week and $158 million in the first week of the month.
Exports in January 1996 totalled $3.473 billion with a daily average of $157.9 million.
